unions.description: IUEC local listed on the IUEC Find Local Union page; its website (https://www.iuec8.org/) mentions training or apprenticeship.
unions.how_to_apply: Contact the local via its website (see the IUEC Find Local Union page).

licensing.name: Contractors State License Board (CSLB)
licensing.description: State board that licenses contractors; its classification pages include C-10 Electrical Contractor, C-36 Plumbing Contractor and C-20 Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air Conditioning.

licensing.name: DIR Electrician Certification Unit (Labor Commissioner)
licensing.description: Certifies electricians and electrician trainees; the page provides exam overviews and certification and trainee forms.

licensing.name: DIR Division of Apprenticeship Standards (DAS)
licensing.description: Administers California apprenticeship law and enforces apprenticeship standards for wages, hours, working conditions and skills.

funding.name: California WIOA training funds via CalJOBS Eligible Training Provider List
funding.provides: The CalJOBS Eligible Training Provider List helps job seekers find training providers funded through WIOA to help cover training costs, and local AJCCs offer a free skills test.
funding.how_to_apply: Search the CalJOBS Eligible Training Provider List; make an appointment with a local AJCC for the free skills test

funding.name: California Employment Training Panel (ETP)
funding.provides: The Employment Training Panel reimburses California companies that train employees for high-skill, high-wage jobs.
funding.how_to_apply: See the ETP fact sheet (DE 8714N) for how to apply
